title: High-Probability Last-Iterate Guarantees for Two-Point Gaussian Zeroth-Order Stochastic Gradient Descent
summary: We establish a direct high-probability last-iterate guarantee for the standard same-sample two-point Gaussian zeroth-order SGD method in smooth, strongly convex stochastic optimization. At each iteration, the method draws a fresh Gaussian direction, evaluates two symmetric perturbations with the same stochastic sample, and takes a norm-normalized stochastic approximation step.
